Definition: Sharetser, the name of an Assyrian and an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Sharezer killed his father in the house of his god, and another Sharezer came to pray before the LORD. Adrammelech and Sharezer, the sons of Sennacherib, smote him with the sword as he worshipped Nisroch, and Sherezer was sent with Regem-melech to the house of God to pray before the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a son who kills his father in his god's house is the end of idolatry, and a man who comes to pray is its opposite.
RelatedPeople: King Hezekiah; Sennacherib, King of Assyria
